title: cullen parvum
intro: Cullen parvum, commonly known as Meadow Rue, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Berberidaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include being used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cullen parvum include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
